leaves.requirements: SciBERT (110 million parameters version) can be used to generate an embedding vector for an input string

evidence.claim: Real allenai/scibert_scivocab_uncased weights were loaded on the authorized AMD GPU and used to recompute CPW/SCW embeddings for four recorded 0.5B-model batches; two cells changed from hash embeddings and the verification gate passed.
evidence.scope_limit: Public encoder embedding capability only; no paper benchmark result and no GPT-3.5/GPT-4o-mini inference

leaves.requirements: RoBERTa base (125 million parameters version) can be used to generate an embedding vector for an input string

evidence.claim: Real roberta-base weights were loaded on the authorized AMD GPU and used to recompute CPW/SCW embeddings for two recorded 0.5B-model StrategyQA batches; two cells changed from hash embeddings and the verification gate passed.
evidence.scope_limit: Public encoder embedding capability only; no paper benchmark result and no GPT-3.5/GPT-4o-mini inference
